english: You are the destroyer of Piśācas; you are the crusher of Piśācas — svāhā!
You are the destroyer of Yātudhānas; you are the crusher of Yātudhānas — svāhā!
You are the destroyer of Sadānvās; you are the crusher of Sadānvās — svāhā!
You are the destroyer of rivals; you are the crusher of rivals — svāhā!
You are the destroyer of the hostile kinsman; you are the crusher of the hostile kinsman — svāhā!
